  have h_main : p s := by
    have h₁ : s.card ≤ n := hs
    -- Apply the given function H to s with the required hypotheses
    have h₂ : p s := H s (fun t₂ ht₃ ht₄ => by
      -- For any t₂, if t₂.card ≤ n and s ⊂ t₂, then use the induction hypothesis
      have h₃ : t₂.card ≤ n := ht₃
      have h₄ : s ⊂ t₂ := ht₄
      -- Use the strong downward induction on t₂
      have h₅ : p t₂ := VTask.strongDownwardInduction H t₂ (by omega)
      exact h₅
    ) h₁
    exact h₂
  exact h_main
